name: Home services and small business
metaTitle: Websites and Automation for Home Services and Small Businesses
description: Techlio builds lead-generating websites and n8n automations for home services companies and growing small businesses, including multi-location operators.
h1: Websites and automation for local businesses, *measured in leads.*
answer: Techlio builds websites that bring in enquiries and automations that handle the follow-up. For Carpet Tech, a home services and restoration company across Texas and New Mexico, we rebuilt the web presence as a lead-generation platform with 10+ city pages, and inbound leads grew 10 to 15% month over month.
problems: A website that looks fine and produces few enquiries
Several locations or divisions competing with each other in search
Enquiries answered late because the team is on a job
Bookings, quotes and invoices re-typed between tools

faqs.question: What should a small business automate first?
faqs.answer: The task that happens most often and follows the same steps each time: usually enquiry follow-up, booking or invoicing. We start with one workflow, prove it saves time, then add the next.

faqs.question: Do you build multi-location websites?
faqs.answer: Yes. Carpet Tech has 10+ city landing pages and four divisions under one brand, structured so each location can be found for its own area.

faqs.question: We are a small company. Is that a fit?
faqs.answer: Yes, for a defined piece of work. A website rebuild or a first set of automations is typically a fixed-scope project; Carpet Tech was delivered in six months.
